description: This file contains shape and tensor utility functions used in PyTorch's JIT compilation, including shape inference, broadcasting, tensor shape transformations, and shape function registration for operators.

methods.name: process_func
methods.description: Scripts a given function and applies JIT passes to inline and optimize the graph.

methods.name: add_shape_compute_mapping
methods.description: Registers a shape inference function for a specific operator schema.

methods.name: add_bounded_compute_mapping
methods.description: Registers shape inference functions with upper and lower bounds for an operator schema.
